body.name: Info
body.def: For chart directions \(u,u^{\prime}\), \(I(\theta_0)[u,u^{\prime}]=\sum_{\ell=1}^{L}p_\ell Dm_\ell[u]^{\prime}\Sigma^{-1}Dm_\ell[u^{\prime}]+\lambda Dd[u]^{\prime}\Sigma_{DD}^{-1}Dd[u^{\prime}]+\tfrac12\operatorname{tr}\{\Sigma^{-1}D\Sigma[u]\Sigma^{-1}D\Sigma[u^{\prime}]\}+\tfrac{\lambda}{2}\operatorname{tr}\{\Sigma_{DD}^{-1}D\Sigma_{DD}[u]\Sigma_{DD}^{-1}D\Sigma_{DD}[u^{\prime}]\}\), where \(m_\ell=(a_{0\ell},A_{\ell\cdot})^{\prime}\) and every derivative is taken through the chart \(\xi\) at \(\theta_0\)
body.role: information per \(n\) observations in the actually observed Gaussian panel
